description: This is a bash shell script that provides CLI commands to interact with OCI containers through a JSON-RPC API via curl. It includes functions to start, stop, list, get info, pause, resume, and execute commands in containers, along with a simple command loop for user interaction.

methods.name: start_container_from_bundle
methods.description: Starts a container from an OCI bundle directory or tarball by sending a JSON-RPC request via curl.

methods.name: start_container_from_spec
methods.description: Starts a container using a Dobby JSON spec by sending a JSON-RPC request.

methods.name: stop_container
methods.description: Stops a running container via JSON-RPC.

methods.name: list_containers
methods.description: Lists all active containers via JSON-RPC.

methods.name: get_container_info
methods.description: Fetches detailed info about a specific container.

methods.name: get_container_state
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a specified container.

methods.name: execute_command
methods.description: Executes a command inside a container with optional parameters.

methods.name: ociconainer_help
methods.description: Displays help information about available commands.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main loop reading user commands and invoking appropriate functions.
